newsitem.title: USA: Armor Holdings buys Defense Tech Corp assets.
newsitem.headline: Armor Holdings buys Defense Tech Corp assets.

text.p: Armor Holdings Inc said on Monday it signed an agreement to buy nearly all the assets of the privately-owned Defense Technology Corporation of America (DTCoA), based in Casper, Wyoming.
The closing will occur on, or about, September 30, Armor said in a statement. Terms were undisclosed.
Armor said the acquisition of DTCoA with sales for fiscal 1995 of about $11 million would have approximately doubled the company's 1995 sales.

Defense Technology Corporation of America manufactures and distributes "less-than-lethal" products including pepper sprays, distraction devices and flameless expulsion grenades to law enforcement and military agencies in the United States and abroad, Armor said.
DTCoA distributes similar products including gas masks, riot helmets and gun holsters, Armor said.
